name: Tom Cole

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING EARLY-CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS' DEDUCTIONS ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING EARLY-CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS' DEDUCTIONS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Vladimir Putin is a tyrant and a war criminal, and we should be clear about what drives him.
Putin seeks to weaken the United States, fracture the West, and undermine democratic institutions.
I recently traveled to Europe on a bipartisan delegation visiting Ukraine and Moldova, our new allies; old friends, Sweden and Finland; and also our historic allies like Great Britain and Denmark.
Putin is a despot waging an illegal and ongoing war against a sovereign nation.
Indeed, one of the European leaders I spoke with said Putin's attack on Ukraine is an attack on all of Europe, and that is true.
This bill will implement an economic onslaught against Putin, his cronies, and the Iranian regime.
As Ukraine continues to bravely fight and Russia's economy strains, this bill will further choke Putin's ability to wage war.
This Congress, alongside the White House and our NATO allies, will continue to make clear that, with our help, a free people will defeat a despotic tyrant.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to support this bipartisan legislation and honor Senator Lindsey Graham's longstanding legacy of steadfastly defending democracy and American values and interests.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AGOA EXTENSION ACT
statements.title: AGOA EXTENSION ACT
sentences: It gives the Nation and our constituents certainty: certainty that the government will remain open, certainty that our servicemembers will be paid, certainty that the TSA will remain operating, certainty that Social Security checks will go out on time, certainty that home buyers will be able to secure mortgages, certainty that the Nation will be protected from foreign threats, certainty that Americans will be able to access nutrition assistance and disaster relief, certainty that roads will be repaired and critical infrastructure projects will continue, and certainty that our elections will be secure.
Frankly, they have the filibuster over there.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Senate amendments to H.R. 6500, the Continuing Appropriations Act of 2027.

Mr. Speaker, I urge all my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to join me in voting for this responsible measure, and I look forward to continuing the FY 2027 appropriations process in the months ahead.
Out of that, I believe we will emerge with a bipartisan compromise that both sides can be proud of and that we can send to the President for his approval.
Then, we will sit down, appropriately, and we will bargain with them and hopefully come to a common conclusion.
Again, I think that is what we will accomplish today if we pass these bills.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: We had to resort to extraordinary measures to continue to fund the Border Patrol.
Why anybody is mad at the Border Patrol, I will never know.
Why the Border Patrol is mixed up in this, I will never know, but I am happy to talk to my friends about it on the other side.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 9770, the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2027.
I know which option I will choose.
I urge my colleagues to join me in voting for this responsible measure, and I look forward to continuing the fiscal year 2027 appropriations process in the coming months.
I will tell you, we have not seen that same sort of good faith from the Senate of the United States, particularly the Senate Democrats.
If we have to wait until after the election until our friends in the Senate want to sit down and work, then we will wait until after the election.

It is a clean, simple CR to avoid a shutdown before a scheduled election and to give us enough time after that election to sit down, either resolve our differences--which is what I hope we can do--or if we need additional time, we will look at that then.
It ensures no artificial deadline, and it ensures we will get the election in the rearview mirror without shutting down the government as we move into an election.
If not, we will try to do this on our own, but we would prefer to do it in cooperation with our friends.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FULL-YEAR CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2025

sentences: We are also maintaining funding for other critical functions of government, including border defense, roads, parks, childcare, water infrastructure projects, biomedical research, job training, and countless others.

We heard a lot about Medicaid.
